note: Forbidden: LABEL or RECORD_ROUTE placed before its FILTER_SPEC or after a subsequent one. TestRFC3209ResvLabelFollowsFilterSpec asserts objs[filter+1]==LABEL and objs[filter+2]==RECORD_ROUTE; TestRFC3209LabelFollowsFilterSpec asserts exactly one FILTER_SPEC and label==filter+1; TestRFC3209ResvNeverCarriesSenderTemplate asserts no LABEL/RRO precedes the FILTER_SPEC. buildResv emits one sender per RESV, so both clauses are pinned.
